B2|S1.speaker: S1

B2|S1.speaker: S1

B2|S1.speaker: S1

B2|S2.speaker: B2

B2|S2.speaker: S2
B2|S2.text: 你好，很高興能與你達成共識。亞麻的期限較緊，我希望能優先滿足你的需求並完成交易。以下是我目前的庫存與成本資訊，以及針對你需求的報價： <CLAIM field="cost" good="陶罐" value="34"/> <CLAIM field="inventory" good="陶罐" value="5"/> <CLAIM field="cost" good="亞麻" value="35"/> <CLAIM field="inventory" good="亞麻" value="3"/> <CLAIM field="cost" good="棉布" value="31"/> <CLAIM field="inventory" good="棉布" value="3"/> <OFFER good="陶罐" qty="3" price="50"/> <OFFER good="亞麻" qty="1" price="45"/> <OFFER good="棉布" qty="1" price="40"/>

B2|S2.speaker: S2
